I had a very strange dream. In the dream I was part of the choir for school, and we'd meet at the gymnasium to sing, I could see music sheets spread on the ground. It felt claustrophobic, or that I was being weighed down by obligation, like when you've got homework that's due tomorrow. But that part wasn't developed much.

Then I remember playing a videogame, which in this dream I was sure existed, which maybe had the initials LILG which I thought meant Life is Worth Living. It was a Telltale-esque game about life decisions with different characters you could meet, and I didn't get past the childhood part since I remembered being a kid while playing the game. But even early on in the game there were two diverging life paths you'd end up on, one where I was in the suburbs with this girl who I was sure was boring, and another where I was in a sleepy town by a forest with a girl who seemed cool, and we went on adventures and so.

I remember thinking while asleep, this is sort of like Life is Strange or maybe Gone Home or something. One of the characters, I think it was the lame one, reminded me of Lily from KS, or was Lily from KS, I'm not sure. This is all my dream logic working.

I was sure that this game existed, and I remember enjoying the conversation I had with the cool girl, when the two of us talked together walking on a dirt pathway somewhere outside town late afternoon, and her dialogue in-game manifested itself as a series of triangles and symbols drawn on a crumpled paper window on screen. Or where they instructions? She was smiling very brightly, so much so I could see the creases on her eyes all wrinkled, and she had a big nose too.

I remember a part of the dream that right now I can't place into time properly, where I woke up in a van with no seats and lots of windows, and the interior was lit this sick green from the lights overhead, like the lights from a wide tunnel road. I saw rice on the roof of the van, since I was lying on my back. I don't remember anyone driving. It doesn't make sense anywhere within the dream.

The part with me in the suburbs in the game in the dream seemed sort of boring, but I guess that was the point. I was walking on the sidewalk late afternoon. I think I was in the lame girl's living room at some point, and I felt this distinct pang of disappointment or sadness and it wasn't because of her but I still pinned it on her for some reason. Other details I could remember reading from online magazines that don't exist. Also, there was a part of the game where I was in an abandoned airport runway, doing heaven knows what. We were in the airport terminal, very late at night, and I was with a squad or whatever clearing the area. No enemies or anything. This part was very video-gamey.

Then still asleep, I went online to look for the game I just played, and I tried searching for it everywhere, but I couldn't remember the title. I tried looking it up online, but I ended up on this Russian subforum about the game since my keyboard was set to Russian. And it was a fancy keyboard too, complicated with a touchscreen in the middle. And I had two keyboards and two monitors. I'm still dreaming at this point.

I finally manage to find a torrent for the game, and I played it, but it started very differently. It was cold, I crossed the bridge to this dark wooden building suspended hundreds of feet up in the air, and I remember crossing more bridges to other places, but they always seemed empty and rusted. Maybe I thought this was the place souls go before they're born, and I had to keep crossing these rickety wooden bridges for the game to start proper. I saw a staircase up in the clouds, and my vision was blurry, and the staircase went up higher but it looked less like I was watching the sky and more like a painting or a picture out of focus.

Then I heard a voice, outside the game but still in the dream that said, "I think I'm in." Maybe I had downloaded the wrong file, and I said this to myself, but my half dead head had scared itself over its own words. And I heard the door to my room opening, I thought it was my father. Which doesn't make sense all things considered.

That's when I woke up. I was on the couch, and my neck hurt badly from staying in the same position for so long. I slept in bed for only two hours, then woke up and slept again on the couch, so I could say that's why this one was strange. I've had dreams like these, where lots of things happen and it's all in the frame of a movie or a videogame and one time a play. I even dream about going on the internet and looking stuff up about the things I just dreamt, and text just ends up being this weird word salad.

Hey, I'm a Koala enthusiast and I have much knowledge on Koalas. IAMA!

That depends on: a) If it's mating season b) If an alpha male is around c) If a joey is around.

Koalas are not as vicious as most people make them out to be. Wild koalas will not want you to come close but if you did see a koala in the wild you would be able to stroke it. An alpha male would be less willing for cuddles but still will not attack you unless you try to hurt it or constrain it. A mother will protect her joey until she dies so if the mother feels like you are going to hurt her joey she will go into a frenzy to stop you.

In all though, koalas are as huggable as you think. You can cuddle lots of them in zoos. Wild koalas do stay away though because they are not used to the treatment.
Can they safely eat anything other than eucalyptus?

Unfortunately no. They have such a specific diet of eucalyptus leaves. Whats even harder for them is that koalas are so fussy on the eucalyptus they eat. Certain eucalyptus trees are designated as sleeping trees, sitting trees and eating trees. They have favorite types of eucalyptus leaves that they eat. If you put a koalas favorite eucalyptus leaves on a plate then they would not eat them as the koala would only eat leaves straight off of a tree; that is how fussy they are. This poor diet leads to them having a low amount of energy and sleeping most of the day.
Have you ever seen the tiny baby joey make its way from the vagina to the pouch? Apparently it's never been caught on film before.

In fact, I've never seen a koala bear in real life before! I'm 17 and live in South Wales (United Kingdom). So no, I have never seen it happen. I remember reading that a joey moving to the pouch from birth had not been recorded but the article was from 2011 so there might be a video out there. After a brief search nothing appeared.

Why Koalas? What interests you about them?

Mainly the fact they are so cute but also that their lifestyle is interesting. One male covers a range of 1-2km of trees and looks after around 10-20 females. They fight as a last resort if they cannot decide who is the most alpha from bellowing. They sleep 18-22 hours a day yet are a fairly strong surviving species. They are declining slowly in numbers and need help but the fact they are still around and are not extinct is amazing.
